title: Add key on Email Message Attachment Data to speed up email deletion (backport to releases/29.x)
summary: A database key was added to the Data field of the Email Message Attachment table to improve performance when deleting emails, avoiding full table scans on large tenants.
key_points: Adds a key on the Data (Media) field of the Email Message Attachment table
Avoids a full table scan per attachment when the platform checks for other references to the same media during deletion
Speeds up email deletion on large tenants, for example the Payables Agent email storage cleanup
Follows the approach of the existing key on the Document Attachment Media field
